plan.title: 机器人运动学、控制与 ROS 2 领域增量追踪深度调研计划
plan.summary: 系统梳理近 1-2 年机器人运动学、控制算法与 ROS 2 生态的前沿进展、经典奠基、工程落地、基准数据集及开放争议，产出可落地的增量快照报告。

subquestions.question: 近 1-2 年（2024-2026）机器人运动学、控制与 ROS 2 集成的前沿进展与 SOTA 突破有哪些？

results.title: On $\ell_2$-performance of weakly-hard real-time control systems
results.snippet: This paper considers control systems with failures in the feedback channel, that occasionally lead to loss of the control input signal. A useful approach for modeling such failures is to consider window-based constraints on possible loss sequences, for example that at least r control attempts in every window of s are successful. A powerful framework to model such constraints are weakly-hard real-time constraints. Various approaches for stability analysis and the synthesis of stabilizing controllers for such systems have been presented in the past. However, existing results are mostly limited…

findings.point: 《Control primitives for robot systems》是机器人控制原语领域的早期奠基性论文，发表于 IEEE ICRA 1990。
findings.evidence: 论文标题为 Control primitives for robot systems，发表于 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 1990，被引 4 次。

findings.attention: 中，作为早期控制原语工作被引用 4 次，属于经典文献但近期关注度有限

findings.point: 《A Mathematical Introduction to Robotic Manipulation》第 4 章《Robot Dynamics and Control》是机器人动力学与控制的教科书级经典章节，由 Murray、Li、Sastry 编著，1994 年 CRC Press 出版。
findings.evidence: 该章节系统推导开链操作器运动方程，利用动力学结构构造渐近跟踪控制律，显式使用 twist 表达运动学，被引 2 次。
findings.authority: CRC Press 学术专著，作者为 Richard M. Murray (Caltech)、Zexiang Li (HKUST)、S. Shankar Sastry (UC Berkeley)，机器人学领域权威教材
findings.attention: 高，作为经典教材章节长期被课程引用与学习，虽引用数较低但教学影响力大
findings.recommendation: ★★★★★ 理由：公认的机器人动力学与控制教科书核心章节，理论推导严谨，是理解现代运动规划与控制算法数学基础的必读文献

The 2024 FMTI reported that transparency was improving, but the 2025 FMTI finds this prog…

results.title: Natural-Language to Nav2: Operational Policies for Costmap-Based Navigation
results.snippet: Autonomous mobile robots support material transport in warehouses and industrial facilities, where navigation must adapt to changing operating conditions. Sensor observations reveal physical obstacles, but do not by themselves specify temporary access rules, route preferences, or exceptions known to operators. This paper presents a natural-language policy interface that brings this knowledge into ROS 2 Nav2. A local large language model converts instructions into JSON policies specifying destinations, spatial constraints, and temporal or event conditions. Deterministic checks govern mission a…

results.title: Improving the ROS 2 Navigation Stack with Real-Time Local Costmap Updates for Agricultural Applications
results.snippet: The ROS 2 Navigation Stack (Nav2) has emerged as a widely used software component providing the underlying basis to develop a variety of high-level functionalities. However, when used in outdoor environments such as orchards and vineyards, its functionality is notably limited by the presence of obstacles and/or situations not commonly found in indoor settings. One such example is given by tall grass and weeds that can be safely traversed by a robot, but that can be perceived as obstacles by LiDAR sensors, and then force the robot to take longer paths to avoid them, or abort navigation altoget…

findings.point: Nav2 支持自然语言策略接口，可将操作员的自然语言指令转换为 JSON 策略并投影到现有导航栈的 costmap 中，无需修改 planner/controller
findings.evidence: 论文提出 Natural-Language to Nav2 接口：本地 LLM 将英文指令转为 JSON 策略（目的地、空间约束、时间/事件条件），经确定性检查后由三个 costmap adapter 投影到 Nav2；在 150 条研究员编写的英文指令上，四个本地模型产生 107-142 条正确接受的策略，规则基线仅 44 条
findings.attention: 中 - 新投稿论文，展示 Nav2 与 LLM 融合的最新工程实践
findings.recommendation: ★★★★☆ - 直接展示 Nav2 可扩展性与真机落地潜力，适合关注导航栈二次开发的工程师阅读

findings.point: Nav2 在农业户外环境（果园/葡萄园）中受限于高草、树冠等非结构化障碍，需实时局部 costmap 更新增强鲁棒性
findings.evidence: 论文指出 Nav2 在户外农业场景功能受限，障碍物如高草、树冠不常见于室内；提出实时局部 costmap 更新方法以改善此类环境下的导航表现
findings.attention: 中 - 针对农业机器人这一细分真机落地场景的改进工作
findings.recommendation: ★★★☆☆ - 为户外非结构化环境下 Nav2 落地提供参考，但为预印本且未给出定量基准对比

findings.point: 当前候选证据仅覆盖 Nav2 相关最新进展，缺乏 ros2_control、MoveIt 2、Isaac ROS、micro-ROS 等核心栈的版本特性、生态成熟度与真机案例证据
findings.evidence: 提供的 3 条候选证据中仅 [35][36] 涉及 Nav2，[29] 为基础模型透明度指数与机器人软件栈无关；其余项目无任何版本号、功能特性、采用度或真机部署记录
findings.attention: 高 - 直接影响本子问题的完整回答能力
findings.recommendation: ★★★★★ - 必须补充检索上述项目的官方发布说明、GitHub Release、ROS 2 发行版文档及真机案例研究
